_comment: The raw properties object of an opencode serve `permission.asked` bus event. PROVENANCE, corrected by QA: this was NOT captured from a live interactive Ask serve (no opencode binary in the run container). The SHAPE below is the authoritative `PermissionRequest` schema read out of the real opencode 1.18.32 linux-x64 binary: { id, sessionID, permission, patterns[], metadata{}, always[], tool?{messageID, callID} } — the built-in edit/write tool asks with permission="edit", patterns = worktree-RELATIVE paths, metadata.filepath = the absolute path, metadata.diff = the patch. NOTE the MCP-tool ask shape is DIFFERENT and carries no detail at all (permission=<mcp tool key>, patterns=["*"], metadata={}), which the consent core cannot key from — see the QA finding on this work item. If a live payload disagrees with internal/askorchicon/consent.go's candidate keys, the live payload wins and extractAskAction is corrected.
_captured: schema read from opencode 1.18.32 (npm opencode-linux-x64@1.18.32) — NOT a live serve capture.
